business: Abora Automation (sets up a missed-call SMS/WhatsApp reply and enquiry summaries for trade businesses)
by_segment: Established business, 6-15 employees, partner or office help does the phone
why_not: My family already answers the phone part of the day and I call everyone back in the evening, so I don't see jobs slipping away. I'm not paying 990 euros plus 149 a month to fix a problem I don't have.

My order book is full for months, so a missed call doesn't cost me anything, and I already sort things out with people on WhatsApp myself. Paying 990 € plus 149 € a month to collect even more enquiries I can't take on makes no sense for me.
A brand-new outfit with no customers wants 990 euros up front and 149 a month for something that sends an SMS. Nobody I know uses it, and I'm not paying to be someone's guinea pig at sixty.
A brand-new company with two founders and not one customer, and they want to sit between me and my callers? Nobody I know uses it, so I'm not paying 990 euros to be their guinea pig.

I'm on my own and already have more callers than I can handle, so 990 setup plus 149 a month (almost 1,800 a year) is too much for SMS replies I can partly do myself with a WhatsApp Business auto-reply. And I'm not handing my phone forwarding to two guys who don't have a single customer yet.

I do want more jobs and I already live on WhatsApp, but 990 euros up front plus 149 a month is real money when I only take home about 35k, and I could set up an auto-reply in WhatsApp Business myself for free.
flip: Proof from my own phone that I'm actually losing calls I never get back to, say a month of missed-call numbers that never rang again, plus a free trial with no setup fee.
